title: A sheaf of sets is covered by extensions of finite constant sheaves on basis opens
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $\mathcal B$ a basis of its topology, and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of sets on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Then there are a set $I$, opens $U_i\in\mathcal B$, finite sets $S_i$, and an epimorphism of sheaves $\coprod_{i\in I}j_{U_i!}\underline{S_i}\to\mathcal F$, where $j_{U_i!}$ is extension by the empty set [def-weil-pbc-sets-extension-by-empty].

source.place: Modules, Lemma Tag 0CAH (lemma-surjection), line 2992 and proof: choose basis neighbourhoods of germs and use the adjunction for j_! (00A3)
